question: If rₚ be partial correlation computed on sample TAB,꜀ computed from sample of size n, the test statistic for significance testing is
solution:
The correct answer is t = frac{{{r_p}sqrt {n - v} }}{{sqrt {1 - r_p²} }} 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Partial correlation** is a statistical measure that represents the strength of the relationship between two variables, after controlling for the effect of one or more additional variables.
 
• The **test statistic** for significance testing of partial correlation, rp, is used to determine if the partial correlation between two variables is significant and non-zero.
 
• The formula for the test statistic for partial correlation is given as: t = frac{{{r_p}sqrt {n - v} }}{{sqrt {1 - r_p²} }}, where n is the sample size and v is the number of control variables. The numerator of the formula represents the strength of the partial correlation, and the denominator represents the standard error of the estimate.
 
• The value of t obtained from this formula can then be compared to the critical value of t from a t-distribution table with (n - v - 2) degrees of freedom, to determine the significance of the partial correlation. If the calculated t-value is greater than the critical value, the partial correlation is considered significant and non-zero.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Partial correlation** is used to study the relationship between two variables after controlling for the effects of other variables.
 
• The test statistic for partial correlation is a ratio of the strength of the partial correlation to the standard error of the estimate.
 
• The calculated t-value is compared to a critical value from a t-distribution table to determine the significance of the partial correlation.
 
• A significant and non-zero partial correlation indicates that there is a relationship between the two variables being studied, after controlling for the effects of the control variables.
